statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis codes R55, I48.0, I48.91 were used
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities
The intermittent nature of symptoms necessitates correlation with arrhythmic activity
